articles.title: Iran deploys submarines to Strait of Hormuz amid US tensions
articles.summary: A market snapshot outlines predictive pricing for two key events. The 'Trump Project Freedom Restart Dates' market indicates 2.3% YES for May 15 and 37.5% for May 31, showing speculation on a US initiative. Crucially, the 'Strait of Hormuz Ship Transit' market registers 47.0% YES, reflecting market sentiment on maritime activity in this vital global chokepoint.

articles.title: Iran says its small subs deployed to Strait of Hormuz as expert explains threat: ‘Vulnerable to detection’
articles.summary: Iran has deployed small submarines in the Strait of Hormuz, terming them an 'invisible guardian' amidst escalating tensions and rejected peace deals with the U.S. This strategic move underscores Iran's intent to assert control over the critical waterway, potentially increasing regional instability. For SSB aspirants, this highlights ongoing geopolitical challenges and maritime security implications in a crucial chokepoint.

articles.title: How to bet on PGA Championship 2026: Betting guide, odds, picks, field, tips, promos, offers at Aronimink
articles.summary: The 108th PGA Championship, a significant golf major, commences on May 14th at Aronimink Golf Club in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. This prestigious event gathers golf's greatest international players for the second major championship of the season, promising high-stakes competition among the world's elite.
